% The brand's setup: its typeface, found by path in the document's own directory (luaotfload reads no search path), and
% its colours, which come from the design data.
\RequirePackage{fontspec}
\RequirePackage{graphicx}
\RequirePackage{xcolor}
\setmainfont{lmroman10-regular.otf}[Path=./]
\definecolor{ab-slate}{HTML}{<<palette.slate>>}
\definecolor{ab-moss}{HTML}{<<palette.moss>>}
